questions.explain: Betaflight is firmware for manual flight: minimal latency and a tunable response.

questions.q: What should you do right after the first FC flash?
questions.explain: A backup before changes is your restore point. The props, by the way, should already be off.

questions.q: Where does Betaflight store its configuration?
options: In a file on an SD card
questions.explain: The configuration lives on the board and is exported with diff all / dump.

questions.q: How does diff all differ from dump?
options: diff doesn't include profiles and rate profiles
diff is only the differences from defaults
questions.explain: diff all is readable and can be carried between versions with some thought; dump drags along every default as an explicit value.

questions.q: What is a target when flashing?
options: The video transmitter channel for the flight
questions.explain: The target describes the board: processor, gyro, pins. Wrong target — NOGYRO and dead ports.

questions.q: What does BUILD KEY in the status output show?
options: A hash of the diff all file for verification
questions.explain: Cloud Build uses it to reproduce the same build; diff all doesn't contain it — save the status output.

questions.q: The LOAD flag among the arming flags:
options: The diff wasn't loaded after flashing
questions.explain: CPU overload: pid_process_denom = 2 or turn features off; tasks shows the heavy tasks.

questions.q: What does the gyro task do in Betaflight?
options: Reads the gyro and filters the signal
Puts the OSD on the video
questions.explain: The gyro task reads the gyro (up to 8 kHz) and runs the filters; the PID task computes the output.
